# Mary Joe

## Overview

- **Origin:** the creek  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Mary Joe is a young [French](../codex/factions.md#french) woman from the creek. She is characterized physically by a buxom build and a broad face.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028)_

## History

Mary Joe is a character who appears during a medical crisis at the [Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) household. She is present when Diana's younger sister, [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md), falls dangerously ill with croup while the adults are away. She is relieved when [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrives to draw on her past experience caring for infants and successfully treat the sick child throughout the night.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P3](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P4](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII.
